items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWEE mentions playing blues in a studio session with Johnny Hammond and Benny Goodman; INTERVIEWER supplies 'Charlie Templeton' as the pianist, but the interviewee does not explicitly confirm knowing or playing with Templeton, only that Templeton was the person playing.

ctx.x: No I wasn't broadcasting. I was a guest. Johnny Hammond was a moderator on a thing called Jam Session on CBS, and he had me as his guest. One night--Benny would remember this--Benny Goodman was in Boston, another band in Chicago and we were here in New York, in the studio, CBS studio, and we all played the blues. Johnny Hammond was the moderator, and we all played the blues and it came out on the air as if we were in one place, and this guy--what's this guy playing the piano?
